notes: Best balance for a personal historical-research workspace; free non-commercial research services, relationships, maps/timelines/network, CSV/TSV import, Zotero-related import support. Claim/Evidence is modeled rather than native.

Closest native match to Entity/Statement/qualifier/reference. Strong OpenRefine integration. Visualization and day-to-day historical curation are less integrated; Cloud hosting policy must be checked for long-term fit.

Best functional fit. Hosted free account terms currently restrict registration to researchers/academics; free hosted tier also lacks API/public front-end. Self-hosting is open source but adds infrastructure.
Lowest-friction structured editor. Excellent fallback if humanities platforms become cumbersome, but requires external visualizations and more of Atlas' semantics to be maintained manually.
